Photos.Caption: T-bone steak cooked on the Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText:
We purchased this grill at the start of the 2021 grilling season to take with us on our day trip excursions.  This grill is lightweight, compact and extremely versatile - capable of EASILY cooking enough burgers and steak for 6-8 people in short order.  At one point during the summer we were using this grill everyday to cook lunch and dinner and on the odd occasion even breakfast using the optional griddle plate.  The Q1200 follows similar design language to previous Weber Q models however, there are some notable features in the Q1200 that make the tiny price premium over the standard Q1000 worth splurging on.  These features include sturdy thermoplastic side tables that fold into the grill for storage, a temperature gauge, increased dome height (great if you like cooking taller items like whole chickens), and lastly, a fully electronic ignition system that is fast, easy, and reliable to use.  

The grill's interior sports a porcelain enamel coated cast iron cooking grate that is strategically designed to shield the gas ports (to prevent clogging and flare ups) on the burner from the food drippings.  Heat is very even and can get hot enough to sear steaks without much effort.  The gas inlet port is integrated with the gas pressure regulator and is designed such that it can accommodate the standard 1lb propane camping cylinders or be used with larger home style BBQ tanks using the accessory gas hose.  

While this grill is typically marketed to ideally cook for 4 that in reality, this grill has EASILY cooked for 6-10 people.  The grill space is generous and the height of the domed lid allows you to push food right to the edge of the grill to maximize your cooking space.  I’ve cooked 5 large steaks, a whole chicken along and have made an entire 3 course breakfast for 6 using the accessory griddle plate.

Cleanup is a cinch as the grill's smooth curving design allows fat and grease to slide into a generously sized drip tray located centrally at the bottom of the grill.  The cooking grates, while mostly cleanable by simply burning it off can be easily removed in 2 small sections and soaked in a sink of warm soapy water.  

Weber not only created the perfect portable grill but they’ve escalated the Q name into another world by offering an entire ecosystem of Q series accessories.  The list of useful add-ons is extensive and allows a Q owner to scale their grill to suit their needs.  I’d argue this grill is so versatile that it can likely outperform (if not outright replace) lesser home BBQs.  

I have trusted the Weber name for the past 20 years and expect nothing but quality and perfection and the Weber Q1200 is no exception.  Its extremely well made and I would expect this thing to easily last me 20+ years.  Like all Weber products, you can buy replacement parts for their grills at VERY reasonable prices much of which, are still available for 30+ year old products.  

Look no further if you’re considering a compact grill.  Nothing in this size and price class can even compete with the Q series grill.  Competitors have tried numerous times to make a better product but end up copying elements of Weber’s design.  I guess copying and mimicking a Weber Grill is the greatest form of flattery after all :)

I love the size of this grill and it appearance.  I love the fact that parts can be washed in the dishwasher.  I love the small gas tank needed.  (I am close to 80 and don’t like lugging around those huge tanks!)

Results.ReviewText: I have had many Weber grills in my lifetime, starting in 1977. Every one has been an excellent product. However, now I have 8 Webers. The Qs are my go-to grills and they are used about 80% of the time as they are easy to use, reliable, work extremely well and the right size. But the best part is the wonderful Weber service we always have received over those 45 years. I fairly can say it is the best and most consistent service we have received from any company. Great job!
Results.Title: Weber Q and service

Results.ReviewText: Excellent little grill for the most part, which reflects Weber's consistency in excellent quality and overall design. The gas-control knob actually does regulate the flame very well to provide different cooking settings. I have had other Weber grills (gas and charcoal) and they were all good investments for the money. My current purchase of the Q1200 portable grill has, so far, been a very good experience, but there are a couple of minor aspects of the product's design that could use improvement.  First is my frustration in cleaning cast iron grates which constantly need attention to mitigate food residue and fat buildup.  Coating the cast iron grates with a ceramic enamel coating only improves the cleaning process minimally.  Polished stainless steel grates, which for me, has been easier to clean, should be offered at least as an upgrade option.  Second, the interior surface of the lower cook-box should be polished to a smoother finish in order to facilitate better drainage of food juices and debris to the little collection pan underneath. Even with the current design being well-executed, buildup on the wall surfaces is still a problem.  This clean-up issue has been experienced in my other grill (Weber 'Spirit II') as well, and may or may not be something Weber can reengineer economically.  But, ..at he end of the day, ..I'm still happy in my purchase.  Weber continues to be the leader in grilling products.  Thanks for listening.
Results.Title: Quality of Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this about 6 weeks ago and apparently I did not have it connected properly and it did not heat to exoectations. I sent in my disappointment and immediately received a response from Customer Service with suggestions on what may be wrong.  I did what they recommended and it now works perfectly!  Heats up beautifully even in the now much cooler weather.  Grilled a rubbed tri-tip to perfection. Seared it at 450 degrees 5 minutes per side then moved it to the left side of the grill (large side toward flames) reduced heat to about 325 and removed after 15 minutes, let sit 15 minutes and BEST EVER eating yet!  Buy this grill!

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your grill is not getting hot enough. Your grill should easily reach 500F, which is hot enough to cook and sear. It should also be able to maintain temperature even on chilly winter days.

If you have too many items on the grate, or if the grill's lid is left open, this will prevent your grill from working as designed. 

Our Support team is reaching out to you now via email to make sure that your grill is working properly. We want you to love your new grill!

Results.ReviewText: We have always been Weber customers.  We are enjoying our new Q grill; it's very easy to use and move around on the deck. We, also, purchased the Q 1000/2000 Gas Grill Rolling Cart but it's not very stable, especially when I clean the grates.  Also, the assembly directions weren't very clear.
